To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

we have computed the permeability of a gas of small instantons in the presence of the large scale vacuum fluctuations, and that we have estimated the bag constant and the string tension under the assumption that it is infinite outside the large bag.
the instanton gas is a phase transition medium with the critical temperature of 200 MeV and that the instanton density in the medium is 0.1 fm ^{-3}.

the instanton gas has the same properties as a paramagnetic gas, that the permeability of this gas is finite and is proportional to the inverse of the instanton density, that the equation of state of the instanton system is the same as the equation of state for a paramagnetic medium, and that the bag constant is proportional to the square of the permeability.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the study of the phase transition of the instanton vacuum in the presence of the color electric field and the large scale fluctuations.
the following questions: (1) What are the properties of the vacuum of QCD? (2) What is the structure of the instanton liquid and what are its properties?

the following questions: 1) What is the phase diagram of a gas of instantons? 2) What are the physical properties of a medium of small instantons? 3) What is the equation of state of a medium of instantons with a large color electric charge density?
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
there is no phase transition at all.
, while the instanton gas picture is a good starting point to describe the vacuum of the QCD, the vacuum is not a gas of instantons.
we have not been able to prove that the instanton gas can be used to describe the confinement of quarks and gluons.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the phase-transition is of the first order, and that the instanton gas in the high-temperature region is a superconductor.
the instanton gas with the interactions is the most probable vacuum configuration of the QCD vacuum.
the instanton gas with the large electric field has a first-order phase transition to a color superconductivity at the critical temperature T_c = 0.8 GeV.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the instanton gas is not in the thermodynamically stable state at low temperature.
the bag constant and string constant depend on the temperature.
the bag constant is a nonperturbative quantity.
